Prototype 4 encodes REM (100% pure) primarily through EOG (81%), with EEG (11%) and EMG (8%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows absence of θ (-4.0 dB, sensitivity=17.0) and absence of β_l (+7.7 dB, sensitivity=13.0).
The θ activity is present in 0% of each epoch (transient), with quiescent eye movements (REM 0% active) and atonic muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with REM physiology: confirmed: EOG dominant, EMG atonic; missing: θ elevated.
